history.message: Let's compete fairly. I will not join any price-fixing ring.
Compete fairly—price-fixing is illegal and risky. I will not join any ring.
I will set my own price based on market conditions. Collusion is risky and illegal.
Competing on price is legal and best for buyers. I will not join any illegal ring.
Competing is better for profits. I'll keep my price low for customers.
I will continue to offer the best deal to customers. Competing fairly is the right choice.
